fields.title: Bing SERP record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed lookups (e.g. blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

targetDomain.title: Target domain
targetDomain.description: Normalized (no scheme, no www.) from your input.

targetFound.title: Target found
targetFound.description: True if targetDomain appears anywhere in the top 10 results.

resultCount.title: Result count
resultCount.description: Always up to 10 (Bing's own ceiling for this HTTP path -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md).

results.title: Results
results.description: Full list of {rank, title, url, domain, snippet, isTarget}.
